config.notes: ECU course pages (www.ecu.edu.au/degrees/courses/<slug>) carry a Domestic tab then an International tab in the same HTML. International tab: CRICOS code; fee line "International students - estimated 1st year indicative fee AUD $N" (first-year, per year); Duration; Course Details tab "Semester availability" lists "Semester 1/2: Study full-time at <campus>" (international list is the LAST one on the page). English: "English Language requirements (Band N)" block with the IELTS Academic overall score. AQF level line gives level and award type. Term months from https://www.ecu.edu.au/future-students/applying/important-dates (Semester 1 lectures commence late February, Semester 2 late July). china.ecu.edu.au study-area pages carry no course fields.
